title: Step 1: A Book
story: The village library wants a small catalogue tool. Start with what a book is and how it prints.
goal: Give Book a String() method so printing a Book shows: Title by Author (Year).
hints: fmt uses a String() string method automatically when it prints a value.
return fmt.Sprintf("%s by %s (%d)", b.Title, b.Author, b.Year)
socratic: What does fmt.Println do when the value has a String method?
Which verb prints a number inside Sprintf?
Why does the receiver not need to be a pointer?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Step 1: A Book”?
